title: Compact objects in a generator telescope lie in its ambient thick envelope
statement: Let $C$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] and $A$ an isomorphism-closed full triangulated subcategory admitting coproducts indexed by types in universe $w$ and closed under such coproducts computed in $C$. Let $G,P$ be compact objects of $A$ [def-pc-compact-object]. Suppose $P$ is supplied with a telescope in $C$: objects $X_n$ in $A$ with $X_0=0$, transition arrows $t_n$, distinguished triangles $X_n\to X_{n+1}\to B_n\to X_n[1]$ where $B_n$ is a coproduct of shifts of $G$ indexed in universe $w$, and a colimiting cofan $S$ on the countable family $(X_n)$. Let $s:S\to S$ obey $\iota_n s=t_n\iota_{n+1}$, and suppose $S\xrightarrow{1-s}S\to P\to S[1]$ is distinguished. Then the ambient object $P$ belongs to the thick envelope of $G$ [def-pc-thick-closure]. No generator-detection hypothesis and no ambient coproduct instance is assumed.

source.place: lemma-factor-through, applied to the tower of Tag 09SN (lemma-write-as-colimit), with Tag 094A (lemma-commutes-with-countable-direct-sums)

proof.text: Reindex the supplied ambient cofan by ULift natural numbers in universe w. Closure under these colimits puts its point in A. Restrict its universal property to A.FullSubcategory by constructing the desc morphisms and checking uniqueness on underlying arrows. The resulting coproduct-point isomorphism identifies identity minus the canonical transition shift with the supplied identity minus s. Lift the telescope triangle, correcting its last arrow by the inclusion commShiftIso, and transport it along this coproduct isomorphism.

Apply compact_hom_hocolim to P and the sequence of internal tower objects. Surjectivity of its comparison map represents the identity of P by an element of the colimit of Hom groups. Types.jointly_surjective' gives one stage and a map f from P to that stage; the comparison equations give f followed by the stage inclusion and q equal to the identity of P.

The initial internal stage is zero, hence isomorphic to the empty coproduct of shifts of G. Each attaching point B_n belongs to A by the distinguished triangle and its two adjacent stages. Restrict the ambient attaching cofan using the shift-commutation isomorphisms to obtain B_n isomorphic to an internal coproduct of shifts of G. Lift the stage triangle and inverse-rotate it. Its first vertex is B_n[-1], a coproduct of shifts G[m_i-1], using sigmaComparison for the shift equivalence and shiftFunctorAdd. Apply compact_factorThrough_thickClosure to the unchanged tower, singleton family G indexed by PUnit in universe w, compact object P, and the map f. This gives P to Q to X_n with composite f, where Q is in the internal thick envelope of a finite sum of copies of G. No tail or zero-stage case split is needed.

Let R be the inverse image under the inclusion of the ambient singleton thick envelope of G. The inclusion is triangulated and maps retract equations, so R is triangulated and retract-closed. R contains G; its closure under finite products and the biproduct isomorphism put every finite coproduct of G in R, including the empty one. The universal property triangEnvelope_le_iff now implies R(Q). Compose Q to X_n with the supplied stage inclusion and q. The factorization equation and the identity equation from compact Hom exhibit P as an ambient retract of Q. Ambient retract closure proves the conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09SP finite-stage factorization combined with Tag 094A compact Hom for the supplied telescope; full-subcategory transport proved in Lean; zero initial stage treated as an empty coproduct

A compact object in a triangulated category generated by a compact generator belongs to its thick triangulated envelope

from.place: right adjoint commutes with direct sums: compact isomorphism tests, through compact-object representatives and compact-to-perfect

lean.statement:
theorem compact_generator_ambient_thick
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ]
    [Preadditive C] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive]
    [Pretriangulated C] [IsTriangulated C]
    (A : ObjectProperty C) [A.IsTriangulated] [A.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    [HasCoproducts.{w} A.FullSubcategory]
    [∀ I : Type w, A.IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)]
    (G : A.FullSubcategory) (hG : IsCompactObject G)
    (P : A.FullSubcategory) (hP : IsCompactObject P)
    (X : ℕ → A.FullSubcategory) (t : ∀ n : ℕ, (X n).obj ⟶ (X (n + 1)).obj)
    (hzero : IsZero (X 0).obj)
    (hsteps : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (I : Type w) (m : I → ℤ)
      (B : Cofan (fun i : I ↦ G.obj⟦m i⟧)), Nonempty (IsColimit B) ∧
      ∃ (a : (X (n + 1)).obj ⟶ B.pt) (b : B.pt ⟶ (X n).obj⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk (t n) a b ∈ distTriang C)
    (S : Cofan (fun n : ℕ ↦ (X n).obj)) (hS : IsColimit S)
    (s : S.pt ⟶ S.pt) (q : S.pt ⟶ P.obj) (r : P.obj ⟶ S.pt⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hs : ∀ n : ℕ, S.inj n ≫ s = t n ≫ S.inj (n + 1))
    (hT : Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk (𝟙 S.pt - s) q r ∈ distTriang C) :
    (ObjectProperty.singleton G.obj).triangEnvelope P.obj
